purpose: Separate discovery of recurrent flower-colour biogeographic zones from independent tests of pollinator, climate, topographic and geographic-barrier concordance.

edge_mechanism_alignment.question: Within adequately replicated species, are larger colour discontinuities on fixed photo-graph edges associated with larger external ecological or geographic contrasts beyond generic geographic separation?
edge_mechanism_alignment.statistic: equal-species mean within-species partial Spearman between colour-edge score and external-edge contrast after residualizing both ranked variables on ranked great-circle edge distance
edge_mechanism_alignment.null: reuse the same 999 within-species colour permutations with geometry, geographic distance and external predictors fixed
edge_mechanism_alignment.multiplicity: Holm across all evaluable predictors in the fixed primary family
edge_mechanism_alignment.ordinary_edge_spearman: descriptive sensitivity only, never primary support

shared_zone_overlay.question: If a stable recurrent flower-colour field exists, does its geography align with independently frozen predictor surfaces?
shared_zone_overlay.statistic: opportunity-weighted Spearman correlation between the recurrent colour field and each external barrier/turnover surface
shared_zone_overlay.null: reuse the same 999 species-conditioned null colour fields
shared_zone_overlay.multiplicity: Holm across all evaluable predictors in the fixed primary family

primary_predictor_family.source: Global Biotic Interactions stable versioned integrated data
primary_predictor_family.automatic_radius_rule: before colour inference choose the smallest candidate radius that makes at least 30 metadata-eligible species evaluable at at least 5 graph edges per species; if none passes, not_evaluable
primary_predictor_family.edge_score: Jensen-Shannon divergence between endpoint documented pollinator-interaction compositions after the frozen pollination/flower-visitation interaction-type mapping and additive pseudocount 0.5
primary_predictor_family.claim_ceiling: alignment with documented pollinator interactions, not proof of pollinator-mediated selection

primary_predictor_family.source: GBIF occurrence data independent of the iNaturalist flower-photo sampling frame
primary_predictor_family.automatic_radius_rule: before colour inference choose the smallest candidate radius giving at least 20 retained target-pollinator occurrences at both endpoints for enough edges to make at least 80 percent of metadata-eligible inferential species evaluable at at least 5 edges per species; if none passes, not_evaluable
primary_predictor_family.edge_score: Jensen-Shannon divergence between endpoint four-guild relative occurrence compositions with additive pseudocount 0.5 per guild
primary_predictor_family.high_value_means: stronger turnover in the broad pollinator occurrence proxy
primary_predictor_family.claim_ceiling: pollinator-guild landscape concordance only; occurrence is not a plant-pollination interaction

primary_predictor_family.standardization: global terrestrial z-score for each axis on the frozen external grid
primary_predictor_family.edge_score: Euclidean distance between endpoint four-variable z-score vectors
primary_predictor_family.secondary_decomposition: axis-specific contrasts only if the primary climate predictor is supported; Holm within the four-axis decomposition

primary_predictor_family.standardization: global terrestrial z-score for each input on the frozen external grid
primary_predictor_family.edge_score: equal-weight Euclidean distance between endpoint four-variable z-score vectors

primary_predictor_family.geodesic_sampling: shortest great-circle path at intervals no greater than 10 km including endpoints; for edges shorter than 20 km use the midpoint as the interior sample
primary_predictor_family.edge_score: fraction of interior sampled path points outside the frozen land polygons
primary_predictor_family.claim_ceiling: geographic separation concordance; not proof of historical vicariance

primary_predictor_family.source: HydroRIVERS/HydroSHEDS fixed release recorded at acquisition
primary_predictor_family.threshold_interpretation: approximately long-term average discharge >=100 m3/s under published HydroRIVERS flow-order bins
primary_predictor_family.edge_score: 1 if the shortest great-circle edge intersects at least one frozen HydroRIVERS reach satisfying ORD_FLOW <= 4, otherwise 0
primary_predictor_family.high_value_means: crossing at least one major river

primary_predictor_family.geodesic_sampling: shortest great-circle path at intervals no greater than 10 km including endpoints
primary_predictor_family.edge_score: sum 3 for each adjacent sampled-point realm transition + 2 for each biome transition + 1 for each ecoregion transition
primary_predictor_family.high_value_means: crossing stronger or more numerous established terrestrial biogeographic boundaries
primary_predictor_family.claim_ceiling: concordance with an existing biogeographic classification; these boundaries are not independent physical causes

primary_predictor_family.selection: Standard - 300 selection of major non-overlapping mountain systems
primary_predictor_family.geodesic_sampling: shortest great-circle path at intervals no greater than 10 km including endpoints
primary_predictor_family.edge_score: count transitions in sampled-point GMBA Standard-300 mountain-system membership, treating non-mountain as its own state

external_source_rules.pollinator_radius_selection: automatic coverage-only rule before colour inference; radius cannot change after colour

zone_extraction.per_resample_hotspot_definition: top 10 percent of evaluable field cells within each of the 200 observed resamples
zone_extraction.persistent_zone_seed: cell belongs to the per-resample top decile in at least 60 percent of observed resamples and has at least 100 evaluable resamples
zone_extraction.connectivity: 8-neighbour grid connectivity with longitude wrap across the international date line
zone_extraction.neutral_zone_names: Z01, Z02, ... ordered by descending opportunity-weighted integrated colour-field intensity
zone_extraction.named_geographic_interpretation: only after neutral zones are frozen

zone_annotation.zone_factor_intensity_requirement: zone opportunity-weighted predictor mean at or above the 75th percentile of that predictor over evaluable cells

secondary_pollinator_check.purpose: Compare broad GBIF guild-proxy alignment with direct GloBI interaction alignment where both are evaluable
secondary_pollinator_check.disagreement_interpretation: sampling/interaction specificity uncertainty, not automatic rejection of either layer

claim_ceiling: The strongest supported result is a stable recurrent flower-colour biogeographic zone whose colour discontinuities are statistically concordant with one or more independently frozen ecological/geographic contrast layers after explicit geographic-distance control at the edge-mechanism level. This does not by itself establish causal adaptation, pollinator-mediated selection, or historical vicariance.
